description:
Option sweep, part A: every option of the checksum, encoding, cat, comm, cp, csplit and cut
commands, with their error paths and meaningful combinations.

Error paths print the status and then the diagnostic through `sed`, which folds GNU's curly
quotes (which it uses under the oracle's UTF-8 locale; see UTF8_QUOTES in the existing corpora)
into ASCII ones, so a case compares the words and the status rather than the quote style.

cases.name: opt md5sum: check quiet
cases.script: printf 'hello\n' >/tmp/a; printf '' >/tmp/b; md5sum /tmp/a /tmp/b >/tmp/sums; printf x >>/tmp/b; md5sum -c --quiet /tmp/sums; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: opt md5sum: check status only
cases.script: printf 'hello\n' >/tmp/a; printf '' >/tmp/b; md5sum /tmp/a >/tmp/sums; md5sum -c --status /tmp/sums; echo "status=$?"; printf y >/tmp/a; md5sum --status -c /tmp/sums; echo "status=$?"

cases.name: opt md5sum: check missing file
cases.script: { printf 'hello\n' >/tmp/a; printf '' >/tmp/b; md5sum /tmp/a /tmp/b >/tmp/sums; rm /tmp/b; md5sum -c /tmp/sums; } 2>/tmp/err; echo "status=$?"; sed "s/[‘’]/'/g" /tmp/err

cases.script: seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit -s n 6; ls xx*

cases.name: opt csplit: silent long
cases.script: seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit --silent n 6; ls xx*

cases.name: opt csplit: elide empty
cases.script: seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit -z n /1/ '{*}'; ls xx*

cases.name: opt csplit: suppress matched
cases.script: seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit --suppress-matched n /6/; for f in xx*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; done

cases.name: opt csplit: keep files on error
cases.script: seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit -k n 5 20; echo "status=$?"; ls xx*

cases.name: opt csplit: line out of range
cases.script: { seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit n 20; ls xx* 2>/dev/null; echo end; } 2>/tmp/err; echo "status=$?"; sed "s/[‘’]/'/g" /tmp/err

cases.name: opt csplit: regex no match

cases.name: opt csplit: unterminated regex
cases.script: { seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit n /abc; } 2>/tmp/err; echo "status=$?"; sed "s/[‘’]/'/g" /tmp/err

cases.name: opt csplit: line zero
cases.script: { seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit n 0; } 2>/tmp/err; echo "status=$?"; sed "s/[‘’]/'/g" /tmp/err

cases.name: opt csplit: decreasing lines

cases.name: opt csplit: bad repeat

cases.name: opt csplit: missing pattern
cases.script: { seq 1 12 >/tmp/n; cd /tmp; csplit n; } 2>/tmp/err; echo "status=$?"; sed "s/[‘’]/'/g" /tmp/err
